subject: RE: WellPath SSO attribute sampling & SCIM delta sync evidence
messages:
From: Sasha Morgan <security@wellpathhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: WellPath Compliance Team <compliance@wellpathhealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-20T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: SSO attributes + SCIM delta (date range)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake we need examples and execution evidence for how Redwood handles identities and provisioning for our tenant. Specifically we are asking for:

- SAML assertion samples showing attribute mappings (NameID, email, groups, role_claim) for SSO logins from 2025-05-01 to 2025-06-01 (redact PII as needed)
- SCIM delta export covering 2025-05-15 to 2025-06-15 (adds/updates/deletes)
- Current RBAC role mapping CSV (role id -> role name -> permissions) for the WellPath tenant
- Any short notes on least-privilege controls (service account scoping, delegated admin rules)

Can you confirm turnaround and preferred format? We are on a compressed audit schedule and would like preliminary samples by end of next week if possible. Also please include any links to ticketing (Jira) or a secure Drive where we can pull artifacts.

Let me know if you need a narrow sample smaller than the full range.

Best,
Sasha Morgan
Security & Compliance
WellPath Health

--
Attachment: SIG-intake-form.pdf (stub)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Morgan <security@wellpathhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence request: SSO attributes + SCIM delta (date range)

Hi Sasha,

Thanks for the clear list — we can support all four asks. Proposed plan:

1) We will pull a redacted sample of SAML assertions for the requested range (we usually return CSV of selected assertion fields plus the raw, redacted XML snippet).
2) SCIM delta export will be delivered as JSONL with one record per change (add/update/delete) and a metadata header describing the export window.
3) RBAC mapping will be exported as a CSV.
4) A short narrative (1 page) on least-privilege and delegated admin will accompany the artifacts.

Irene, can you confirm ETA on the SCIM delta and whether we need Prod approval for the export? Laura, tagging you for legal redaction guidance and any constraints on customer-facing sample delivery.

Sasha — if the 2025-05-15 -> 2025-06-15 window is too wide for any reason, tell us which week you care about and we can prioritize.

Target: preliminary samples by EOD 2025-06-24; final packet (if needed) early the week of 2025-06-30.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Note: we'll deliver via secure Drive link and provide a HubSpot ticket (WP-4492) for tracking.

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Sasha Morgan <security@wellpathhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-22T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence request: SSO attributes + SCIM delta (date range)

Hi all,

I pulled the initial exports this morning. Notes:

- SCIM delta: 2025-05-15 -> 2025-06-15 exported as scim_delta_export_2025-06-20_2025-06-23.jsonl. File includes ops: add/update/delete and user/servicePrincipal object snapshots.
- SAML assertions: sampled 120 assertion events; output CSV includes timestamp, nameid, email (redacted), groups, role_claim, and a redacted_xml column with PII removed. Filename: saml_assertion_samples_2025-06-20.csv
- RBAC mapping: exported current role map for tenant as rbac_role_mapping_wellpath.csv

Redaction approach: we replaced user.email/localpart with hashed identifiers and removed IP address fields. I created a short redaction_log_2025-06-24.txt describing fields removed and the hashing salt rotation (internal only).

Open questions for WellPath:
- Do you require hashed identifiers to be reversible for mapping back to WellPath-provided IDs? If so, we need to set up a secure exchange for mapping keys (we can escalate to Encryption Key team).
- Any particular audit fields you need retained (e.g., original_nameid_opaque)?

I'm attaching the file stubs to this message (full files delivered via secure Drive per Mateo). Jira: SEC-1324 opened to track internal work; HubSpot WP-4492 updated.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Platform Security Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: scim_delta_export_2025-06-20_2025-06-23.jsonl (stub); saml_assertion_samples_2025-06-20.csv (stub); rbac_role_mapping_wellpath.csv (stub); redaction_log_2025-06-24.txt (stub)

From: Sasha Morgan <security@wellpathhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: WellPath Compliance Team <compliance@wellpathhealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-23T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence request: SSO attributes + SCIM delta (date range)

Irene / Mateo,

Appreciate the quick pull. A couple quick clarifications before we validate samples:

- Reversibility: for our internal mapping we prefer reversible identifiers for a subset (10-20) of test accounts to confirm entitlement alignment. Can you advise on secure key exchange?
- Retention: please keep original_nameid_opaque for the sample (we will not request full PII).
- Format: JSONL for SCIM is fine; CSV for SAML is fine.

If you can provide one reversible test mapping (encrypted transfer), that'll let us reconcile roles to our HRIDs during review.

Thanks — Sasha

--
One-line reply: Can you confirm when the Drive link will be shared?

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Morgan <security@wellpathhealth.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-24T16:05:00-07:00

Artifacts delivered:
- saml_assertion_samples_2025-06-20.csv
- scim_delta_export_2025-06-20_2025-06-23.jsonl
- rbac_role_mapping_wellpath.csv
- redaction_log_2025-06-24.txt
- reversible_mappings_encrypted.bin (EKM-wrapped, password exchanged out-of-band)

Secure Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-WellPath-Evidence
HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/WP-4492
Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/SEC-1324

If you need the files delivered via SFTP or a signed DocuSign envelope for the reversible mapping key, let me know and we can accommodate. Otherwise we consider this the deliverable for the compliance packet — marking WP-4492 as pending review.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
